Required export shape: import { DatabaseSync } from "node:sqlite" - this is Node's own built-in SQLite module, NOT the "better-sqlite3" npm package, so never import from "better-sqlite3". Export the DatabaseSync instance as a named export `db` (e.g. `export const db = new DatabaseSync(...)`), using `db.exec(sql)` for schema/DDL statements and `db.prepare(sql).run(...)` / `.get(...)` / `.all(...)` for parameterized queries - never string-concatenated SQL. `.all()` and `.get()` return a generic `Record<string, SQLOutputValue>` shape under TypeScript, not your specific row interface, so a direct `as YourType[]` cast will fail to compile - cast through `unknown` first, e.g. `stmt.all() as unknown as Recipe[]`. `DatabaseSync` has no `.query` method, `db.exec` returns void, and these calls are synchronous - do not await them. Do not write the `SQLOutputValue` type yourself.
